additional_info.subject: ID0473004-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / R5 170001926] Blackscreen problem CRM:03275000002
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0473004
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-TR SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
Borusan Oto Lojistik Kartepe-2
Charger ID / Serial No.:
UjxgTO
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason:
Please measure the Voltage between the 24V supply on the PCB.
If the Voltage is between 24/25V and the HMI is not OK verify if the DP cable is properly attached.
If both are OK then replace the HMI.
I will send you all the necessary references for the specific HMI required for this charger :
-8EM5902-1AA02-0AA8 Controlp. RAFI middle segm. contactl. CCR
-8EM5902-1AA00-6AA0 Controlpanel RAFI 3 segments w/ AC cutoutControlpanel RAFI 3 segments w/ AC cutout
-8EM5905-0AA00-8AA6 Controlpanel Adaptation Set
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-TR SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Anass Mezzaoui
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
